groups.activity: pick Zenistar at a weapon milestone (day 100, 300, 500 or 700)
groups.meta: earliest day 100; every account has it by day 700

rows.label: Zenistar
rows.note: offered from day 100; pick it first to have it soonest

conditions: Login days are cumulative, not consecutive; missing days only delays the milestone.
The pick is final; no Alt+F4 or other reroll exists.
bonuses: Arrives fully built with its own weapon slot and an Orokin Catalyst pre-installed.
Clicking the milestone icons under the login-day counter previews what each upcoming milestone offers.

disclosures.title: replacement copy, not a shortcut
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells a Zenistar Blueprint for 100,000 standing, but only after you've claimed it from Daily Tribute. It builds for 30,000 credits, 4 Morphics, 450 Circuits, 500 Polymer Bundle and 2,750 Salvage over a day, and gives no extra Mastery.

disclosures.title: cross-save duplicates
disclosures.body: Accounts merged through cross-save can already own all four milestone weapons and still get handed a duplicate at a later milestone; it comes with its own slot.
